name: claude-hang-after-comment
description: #1404 J7 stop-honesty, comment lane: the stdout stream already carries an `add_comments` tool_use announcement before it hangs — stopping here must resolve `RunPhase::Stopped { delivered: true }` (ux-design.md §2/J7 'STOPPED — partial delivery'), the comment-lane counterpart to `claude-hang-after-propose.json`'s tracked-changes case. Before #1404, `delivered` was read off `AgentSession::saw_propose_changes` alone, so this scenario stopped and reported 'STOPPED — nothing applied' despite the comment already sitting durably in the TD-4 sidecar.
